vibe_rationale: Curated, multi-venue, multi-format design festival with a real community of practice, though institutional and narrower than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Large, design-literate adult audience (120,000 in 2026) with a wellbeing entry point, since the 2026 program covered food and fitness. High Ground could stage its own program entry, but the major partners are a car brand and a telco and partner tiers are not published, so a headline partnership is likely costly.
